scientific_scope: closed-world dimensionless process geometry; not field calibration or visit-accuracy validation

ontology.baseline: no deviation; no classification question is triggered

deviation_truth.target_process: positive latent process; may co-occur with nuisance
deviation_truth.nuisance_process: positive latent process that can mimic, hide, or corrupt target inference; harmless non-target context is not nuisance
deviation_truth.coupling: target-driven change in the nuisance/scene channel; coexistence is allowed and must not be forced into one exclusive class

ontology.observation_layer: observability is independent of nuisance burden and asks whether target presence/absence is inferable from the available measurement channel
ontology.output_layer: visit inference is PRESENT / ABSENT / UNDETERMINED, with reason codes retained; internal target/nuisance support remains non-exclusive

non_indeterminacy_contradiction: process_coupling: target and nuisance can both be true; do not resolve by forcing exclusivity

process_model.target: localized non-stationary transit with entry/exit over normalized target timescale 1
process_model.nuisance: restorative spatially coherent oscillatory scene process with normalized timescale pi2
process_model.coupling: target-triggered local damped flower/scene response added only at the focal location, with amplitude pi4
process_model.neighbor_channel: receives coherent nuisance but not target-triggered local coupling
process_model.direct_target_channel: scaled by pi3 and may become weak independently of the local coupling channel

pre_sweep_predictions: smaller pi1 should increase information-absence because the observation window captures a smaller fraction of target-process structure
smaller pi3 should weaken direct target evidence
pi2 near 1 should thicken the essential-ambiguity band only where other separating evidence is weak; temporal overlap alone is not defined as ambiguity truth
larger pi4 should create a region where indirect local response can rescue target inference when direct target evidence is weak
larger pi4 should also increase legitimate both-supported target+nuisance/coupled states; these must not be counted as classifier errors solely because both channels are high

later_phases.V14b: alternate frozen development of target-focused and nuisance-focused observers using contradiction classes; never co-adapt both on the same step
later_phases.V14c: freeze both observers after contradiction-type saturation and measure residual response surfaces without further tuning
later_phases.open_world_loop: use real/open-world material only to expand process vocabulary, then return new vocabulary to a truth-known closed world before claim-bearing measurement
